articles.title: At last, customers first: AI-powered personalization can help banks create value
articles.summary: Banks can better compete against digital-first rivals by using AI to deliver more effective, hyperpersonalized customer engagement. Here are four key components of this strategy.

articles.title: Unlocking system-wide productivity gains in R&D
Incore Bank trials AI for customer onboarding with automated risk assessment
articles.summary: Switzerland's Incore Bank has run a proof of concept trial with Kyndryl and Google Cloud on the use of AI agents to accelerate customer onboarding while maintaining strong risk oversight controls.

articles.title: WealthAi launches WealthAi for Advisors as advice firms enter next phase of AI adoption
articles.summary: WealthAi, the AI operating system for wealth management, has today launched WealthAi for Advisors, expanding its platform to independent financial advisers and smaller advice firms.

articles.title: Finzly debuts AI assurance layer
articles.summary: Finzly, the banking transformation company, today announced the launch of Assure, an AI-powered security and assurance layer as part of its Agentic Galaxy suite of AI capabilities, powering the infrastructure for BankOS, its modern operating system for banks.

articles.title: RateZip launches live US bank rate and mortgage rate app on ChatGPT
articles.summary: RateZip, an independent US consumer rates platform, today launched RateZip Deposit/Mortgage Rates in the ChatGPT app directory. RateZip Deposit/Mortgage Rates is a live rate service that lets ChatGPT answer questions about current US savings account, certificate of deposit (CD), mortgage, and home equity line of credit (HELOC) rates, with the source and observation time attached to every figure.
